semiconductor_relevance: Medium — The company provides advanced coating technologies and materials, which are crucial for protective films and SOC solutions in semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Shanghai Plusco Tech Co., Ltd specializes in advanced coating technologies and materials, focusing on protective films used in semiconductor manufacturing processes. The company also offers System on a Chip (SOC) solutions and mixed signal test systems, supporting the testing and assembly segments of the semiconductor industry.
capabilities: Protective films for automotive display screens
High-temperature resistant glass support protective films
System on a Chip (SOC) solutions and mixed signal test systems
